whatContradictedTheCard: This seat's own manual verification query used the wrong place_key prefix ('48021:%' instead of the CLI's actual 'node:48021:%'), producing a false reading that staging held zero rows for all six counties. This led to an incorrect intermediate conclusion (recorded and then corrected within this same card) that the staging runs would be vacuous smoke tests. Re-verification with the correct prefix showed staging is a full-fidelity mirror of production. Caught before it reached the close by cross-checking against the job's own reproducible, twice-confirmed output rather than trusting the ad hoc query -- exactly the failure mode ENFORCEMENT.md's 'instrument that produced a claim is part of the claim' section warns about, self-caught this time.

The dispatch's structuralFact overlay question (livingAreaSqft reaching some golds via HTTP while the bake row carried nothing) assumed a single named mechanism; tracing it required finding the actual call site (brokerageNodeFacets.ts / propertyExplorer.ts) since the dispatch did not name the file. No contradiction in the finding itself, just more legwork than the dispatch implied.

declaredTaxYear varied across counties in the live summaries (2025 for 48021/48309, 2026 for 48055/48209/48453/48491) -- this reflects each county's own most-recently-declared CAD roll year via tryResolveDeclaredCadVintage, not a bug; the dispatch did not flag this as a check item but it is worth naming so a future reader does not mistake the variance for an error.
constraintsHonored: no laptop write; every scan/patch executed inside the Cloud Run job
OPERATOR_PUBLISH_GO required and supplied only as an execution-time --update-env-vars override, never a template value
every production run gated on its own county's succeeded staging run (own staging-sibling check, not the conformant pipeline's)
never read cad-parcel-roll atoms (verified by code reading and by count-magnitude cross-check against known hollow-atom figures)
never collapsed a stored $0 to absent, never fabricated a $0 for a null (improvementZero counts differ correctly per county: 6158/24552/36554/0/95783/68483)
did not fill McLennan assessedValue/livingAreaSqft or Travis livingAreaSqft/yearBuilt (all confirmed still 0/absent, matching the dispatch's explicit prohibition)
did not touch schema.sql, engine-core, or any repository other than hauska-factory for the execution mechanism

LESSON: Verify a place_key format against the actual writer's code before trusting a manual spot-check query -- 'node:<county>:<propid>' vs '<county>:<propid>' are both real formats used by different systems in this codebase (LDT's bake vs the Factory's parcel-record-fill), and assuming one from context is a real, reproducible way to get a confidently wrong answer.

A Factory publish-image job that already vendors LDT at a pinned SHA is reusable infrastructure for ANY future LDT bake that needs a controlled execution path -- the pattern (bundler entry + lightweight job + own staging-sibling check + OPERATOR_PUBLISH_GO) generalizes beyond this one card.

When a conformant-pipeline gate (requireStagingSibling) doesn't fit a new job's shape, build a purpose-built equivalent against the same underlying runs table rather than forcing a mismatched reuse or skipping the discipline.
